vata.summary: Your responses indicate a Vata-dominant Prakriti.
vata.about: People with Vata dominance typically have traits associated with air and space elements. They tend to be creative, energetic, enthusiastic and adaptable.
reflections: Notice which daily routines help you feel settled.
Make room for quiet pauses between busy activities.
Reflect on how changes in routine affect your sense of wellbeing.
vata.guidanceText: Explore diet and lifestyle guidance based on your Vata Prakriti.

pitta.summary: Your responses indicate a Pitta-dominant Prakriti.
pitta.about: Pitta-dominant individuals exhibit characteristics aligned with fire and water elements. They are often ambitious, focused and goal-oriented.
reflections: Notice what helps you stay calm and balanced.
Take regular breaks and avoid overworking.
Be mindful of how frustration affects your wellbeing.
pitta.guidanceText: Explore diet and lifestyle guidance based on your Pitta Prakriti.

kapha.summary: Your responses indicate a Kapha-dominant Prakriti.
kapha.about: Kapha-dominant people embody traits related to earth and water elements. They are usually calm, nurturing, stable and steady.
reflections: Stay active and keep your body moving.
Be mindful of tendencies toward inactivity or excess routine.
kapha.guidanceText: Explore diet and lifestyle guidance based on your Kapha Prakriti.
